swirling decorative patterns on surface
glossy finish

symmetrical design

detail.issues: Model A has distorted and incomplete decorative patterns compared to the reference, while Model B has simplified and less detailed patterns with some missing elements.
Model A has incorrect leg shapes and proportions, while Model B has more accurate geometry but still lacks some texture details and color variations compared to the reference.

Both models have similar issues: the white circular design on the bottle is misaligned and less defined compared to the reference, and the bottle's base transparency is incorrect. Model A also shows slight shape variations in the cap and body.

central circular bore with a protruding pin
two symmetrically placed through holes on the outer face
smaller pilot hole above the top through hole

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect hole positions and sizes, and a less accurate surface texture. Model B has distorted geometry, incorrect hole sizes, and a wrong internal structure.

Model A has incorrect cabinet designs with missing drawer details and cabinet handles, while Model B has more accurate cabinet designs but still lacks some drawer and handle details compared to the reference.

Model A has incorrect surface reflectivity and lighting compared to the reference, while Model B closely matches the reference's material and lighting but has minor geometric distortions in the base shape.
Model A has incorrect strap stitching and buckle details, while Model B features a non-existent circular element on the watch back and an incorrect buckle design.

Model A has incorrect knob details and missing side features; Model B has slightly off gemstone faceting and altered knob shapes.
Model A has less defined spiral details and a flatter shape compared to the reference. Model B closely matches the reference but has slightly less contrast in the spiral layers.
